# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — deterministic payment split + free-bag computation + list_reservations tool + read/confirm/execute prompt rules
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file/tool + cluster):
  1. tools.py `book_reservation` + new `_auto_distribute_payment` helper — payment "does not add up" cluster (tasks 8, 23, 25): when supplied amounts ≠ computed total, re-fill gift/cert to balance in listed order and let the credit card absorb the remainder, then re-sync `reservation.payment_history`.
  2. tools.py `_compute_nonfree_baggages` + `FREE_BAGGAGE_ALLOWANCE`, called in `book_reservation` and `update_reservation_baggages` — over-charged-bags cluster (task 12): derive paid-bag count from the policy allowance table.
  3. tools.py new READ tool `list_reservations(user_id)` + `IATA_CITY` map — wrong-reservation-located cluster (tasks 17, 22): one call lists every reservation with origin/destination cities + created_at.
  4. tools.py enriched seat + payment-shortfall error text — recoverable-error cluster (tasks 8, 25).
  5. policy.md "Operating procedure" Rules 1–4 (read-before-write w/ Mei Garcia example, locate-by-description via list_reservations, confirm-then-execute, tools compute money/bags) — narrated-without-action + read-before-write clusters (tasks 40, 11).
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  1. Fixes payment mismatches by reproducing the domain's deterministic split; SAFE because the guard fires ONLY when sum ≠ total — a passing booking already sums correctly and is skipped. Early-returns if a payment_id is missing so the existing not-found check still fires.
  2. Fixes task 12's paid-bag overcharge; SAFE because formula == policy == gold, so an already-correct value is reproduced unchanged.
  3. Lets the agent match "New York→Chicago" to the one reservation to ORD; SAFE — additive read tool, no state change.
  4. Helps the agent self-correct after a rejected write; SAFE — error path only.
  5. Reduces guess/stall/half-done writes; SAFE — additive prose, NO global decision/permission/refusal rule loosened.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — first iteration, RUNMAP/LEDGER/rejected.jsonl all empty.
- Refuted hypotheses: none recorded yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: task 23 full split-into-3-reservations decomposition (arithmetic unblocked by change 1, but the split-decision planning is left to agent + prompt).
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: read this RESULT line — if payment guard or bag computation broke any passing task, redesign the bounded condition; if list_reservations didn't move 17/22, the gap is the MATCH step (consider returning a best-match hint). Consider a composite confirm-then-execute WRITE tool for the narrated-without-action cluster if the prose rule alone didn't fix 40/11.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.433 Δ=+0.133 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={12, 19, 22, 23, 25, 37, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).

# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Payment split (book_reservation)
- What worked (confirmed by a RESULT): pending — cand_0001 is first; read its RESULT.
- Promising but not yet gate-confirmed (verified only by running the tool body on trace args, cand_0001): the domain's payment split is DETERMINISTIC — gift cards/certificates fill to their balance in listed order and a single credit card absorbs the remainder. Encoding this in `book_reservation` (bounded to fire only when supplied amounts ≠ computed total) reproduced gold amounts on tasks 8 & 25. GOTCHA: the Reservation is constructed with a deepcopy of payment_methods BEFORE the payment section, so `reservation.payment_history` must be re-synced after correcting amounts or the stored history stays stale.

## Free baggage (nonfree_baggages)
- Promising but not yet gate-confirmed (tool-body verified, cand_0001): nonfree = max(0, total_baggages − allowance[membership][cabin] × num_passengers), allowance table straight from policy.md. Computing it in `book_reservation` + `update_reservation_baggages` reproduced gold on task 12 (gold economy, total 2 → 0 paid).

## Locating a reservation by description (tasks 17/22)
- Promising but not yet gate-confirmed (tool-body verified, cand_0001): a `list_reservations(user_id)` loop tool returning origin/destination cities + created_at surfaces the right reservation (FQ8APE Newark→Chicago) so the agent can match "New York to Chicago". OPEN QUESTION for next iteration: whether the agent then MATCHES correctly, or whether it needs a returned best-match hint — decide from the RESULT.

## Do NOT guard basic-economy modification
- Promising note (cand_0001, by construction, not yet gate-confirmed): gold tasks 17/22 legitimately change a basic_economy reservation's cabin+flights, so a "basic economy cannot be modified" code guard would REGRESS them. Left as prose.

# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (first, empty seed)
- Strategy tried: diagnose ALL clusters from trajectories first, then ship a multi-class candidate in one pass (code guards + a new loop tool + enriched errors + additive prompt rules), preferring deterministic code over prose per the tools SKILL. Val effect unknown yet (harness stamps RESULT after stop; LEDGER empty going in).
- Diagnosis leverage: a small reusable trace-extractor (gold from metadata.tau2_reward_info.action_checks, agent calls from raw_data.choices) made per-task root-causing cheap enough to skip subagent fan-out. Verifying each fix by running the actual tool body on the exact trace args (in venv-skillberry-tau2) caught a real bug — payment_history stayed stale after the guard corrected the amounts list — that static reading would have missed. KEY META-LESSON: always execute the guard, don't just read it.
- Plateau/stall signal: n/a (first iteration).
- What to try next iteration: read the RESULT line before designing. If a bounded guard broke a passing task, the bound was wrong — narrow the fire condition, don't drop the fix. If list_reservations didn't move 17/22, the failure is the MATCH step not the LOOKUP — try returning a ranked best-match hint. For any still-open narrated-without-action task, escalate from prose (this iteration) to a composite confirm-then-execute WRITE tool (SKILL lever 2). Keep candidates multi-class but keep every guard bounded.

# PROCESS — iteration cand_0001 (empty-seed baseline; val 0.300 = 0 solid / 7 flaky / 3 failing)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage; diagnosed from ./trajectories/ t0–t2)
| rank | cluster | tasks (trials) | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | book_reservation "Payment amount does not add up" (many occurrences) + "Not enough balance in gift card" | 8, 23, 25 | agent cannot reliably compute the exact total or split it across payment methods; tool rejects the whole write on any mismatch | BEHAVIORAL / CAP-GAP | in-body auto-distribution guard (code) |
| 2 | wrong reservation modified — user describes route ("New York→Chicago"), agent guesses / asks user to pick / picks wrong | 17, 22 (always-fail) | no easy way to locate a reservation by route or recency; agent loops get_reservation_details or guesses | CAP-GAP | new loop tool `list_reservations` + prompt Rule 2 |
| 3 | over-charged / wrong PAID-bag count (nonfree_baggages) | 12 | agent forgets the free baggage allowance (membership×cabin×pax) and charges for free bags | KNOWLEDGE→CODE | deterministic in-body computation |
| 4 | narrated-without-action / read-before-write miss | 40, 11, 8 | agent proposes a change, user confirms, agent never executes; or updates passengers without re-reading current DOBs | BEHAVIORAL | prompt Rules 1 & 3 (+ worked examples) |
| 5 | recoverable errors strand the agent (opaque seat / payment errors) | 8, 25 | error text lacks the info needed to retry | KNOWLEDGE | enriched, actionable error returns |

## Changes made this iteration (multiple classes: code guards + new tool + enriched returns + prompt)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body guard (code) | tools.py `book_reservation` + new `_auto_distribute_payment` | when provided amounts ≠ tool-computed total, re-fill amounts (gift/cert → balance in listed order, credit card absorbs remainder), then re-sync `reservation.payment_history`. Mirrors the domain's deterministic split → reproduces gold amounts | Fires ONLY when sum ≠ total (the failing condition). Passing bookings already sum correctly → guard skipped → untouched. Returns early if a payment_id is missing so the existing "not found" check still fires. |
| 3 | in-body computation (code) | tools.py `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_baggages`, helper `_compute_nonfree_baggages` + `FREE_BAGGAGE_ALLOWANCE` | derive nonfree = max(0, total − allowance×pax) from the policy table instead of trusting the agent's number | Formula == policy == gold, so an already-correct value is reproduced unchanged. |
| 2 | new loop / read tool + enriched fields | tools.py `list_reservations` + `IATA_CITY` | one call returns every reservation with origin_city / destination_city / created_at / route so the agent matches by city or recency; collapses N repeated get_reservation_details calls | Additive READ tool; no state change; tasks that don't need it are unaffected. |
| 5 | enriched errors | tools.py seat errors (book + update), payment-shortfall error | error now names available seats by cabin / the uncovered amount + next step | Only on the error path; success path unchanged. |
| 2,4 | additive prompt rules + worked examples | policy.md "Operating procedure" (Rules 1–4) | read-before-write (copy unchanged fields/DOBs verbatim), locate-by-description via list_reservations, confirm-then-execute, note that tools compute money & bags | ADDITIVE knowledge/behavior; NO decision / permission / refusal rule loosened. |

## Verify-the-fix (ran the tool bodies in venv-skillberry-tau2 against exact trace args)
- PAYMENT task 25: book ivan_muller HAT097+HAT251 econ, pay gift 128 + credit **100** (wrong) → corrected payment_history = gift 128 + credit **247** (== gold). Correct input (128+247) → unchanged (SAFE). credit-only → absorbs 375. gift-only-insufficient → actionable ValueError listing balances.
- PAYMENT task 8: single certificate amount 100 (wrong) → corrected to 348 (full total, single method, == gold).
